## Who

## What he does

- Puts models where they must survive production: agent workflows, tool calling, structured output
  (JSON Schema), MCP and RAG integration — with retries, replayable state and human handoff
- Async state machines and idempotency: model APIs, third-party platforms and chain interfaces turned
  into modules that can be retried, replayed and debugged
- Retrieval that works: full-text + vector hybrid recall, score fusion, rerank, Chinese tokenisation and
  near-duplicate dedup
- Owns the whole line solo: API and schema design, React front end, Docker deployment, GPU model serving,
  production debugging
- Hands over: 1–2 week usable version first, then idempotency, retries, human takeover and rollback;
  acceptance checklist, runbook and deploy scripts ship with the system

## Public evidence

- IDM-Activation-Script-Chinese — Windows batch toolkit, distribution and maintenance at real scale
- cleanplate — local-first AI video watermark removal backend (FastAPI + ComfyUI DiffuEraser)
- PromptPanel — macOS prompt/snippet launcher (Swift/SwiftUI), full docs/CI/test/release loop
- bilibili-cleaner — bulk account cleanup with review gates and rate limits (FastAPI + Web UI + CLI)
- macfriends-cli — WeChat relationship inspection on macOS (Rust + ObjC++ agent), strictly local
- bazi-master — full-stack AI divination web app (React + Express + PostgreSQL + Prisma)

In-house work (AI automation platform, content pipeline, image platform, Chinese hybrid search) is
mentioned in one line only: no company name, no source, no production data. Architecture is open for a call.
